title.zh: 单次各向异性反演试探

summary: Evaluate one parameter mapping through caller-owned equilibrium and diagnostic callables, reduce its observation residuals, or record a fixed penalty if a nested evaluation fails.

identity.relation: one parameter proposal and caller-owned scientific ports to an inversion trial residual record
identity.direction: params, observations, solver_config and three callables -> params, chi2, residuals, equilibrium, failure_reason
identity.definition: Copy solver_config, set its params to a copy of the trial mapping, and invoke equilibrium_solver once. Pass its result, solver_config's r_grid/z_grid as R/Z, and observations to diagnostic_evaluator; then call residual_reducer(predicted=..., observations=...). Preserve the reducer's residual vector and chi2, and read equilibrium.converged/failure_reason. An exception in this nested sequence yields residuals=[1e12], chi2=1e24 and equilibrium=None.
identity.model: caller-specified equilibrium and diagnostic forward model with SciRel-owned trial wiring and fixed exception penalty
identity.geometry: supplied by solver_config and caller callables; this Operator performs no geometric calculation
identity.coordinates: R and Z are copied from solver_config.r_grid and z_grid without conversion; diagnostic channels retain caller order until reduced
identity.boundary: No parameter bound check is performed here; the outer optimizer owns bounds. The fixed penalty is an exception response, not proof of physical infeasibility.
assumptions: The caller's equilibrium_solver accepts a single mapping and returns a mapping with converged and failure_reason.
The diagnostic_evaluator accepts one mapping and the residual_reducer accepts predicted and observations keywords; these ports carry the scientific meaning of the forward calculation.

inputs.name: params
inputs.description: Trial parameter mapping copied into solver payload and returned record.
inputs.constraints: Must support dict(params); individual scientific ranges are not checked here.

inputs.name: observations
inputs.description: Diagnostic requests and measured values passed unchanged to the diagnostic and reducer.
inputs.constraints: Must be accepted by both injected ports; this Operator does not inspect its structure.

inputs.name: solver_config
inputs.description: Fixed equilibrium configuration with r_grid and z_grid for the diagnostic call.
inputs.units: mixed; R/Z grids m when using cylindrical model
inputs.constraints: Must support dict(solver_config) and keys r_grid/z_grid; its params key, if present, is overwritten by trial params in the copied payload.

inputs.name: equilibrium_solver
inputs.description: Caller-owned forward equilibrium calculation invoked with copied configuration plus trial params.
inputs.constraints: Successful result provides converged and failure_reason keys; callable validity is enforced by invocation rather than an upfront check.

inputs.name: diagnostic_evaluator
inputs.description: Caller-owned synthetic diagnostic calculation on the trial equilibrium.
inputs.constraints: Receives the equilibrium even if it reports converged=False; scientific validity is caller-owned.

inputs.name: residual_reducer
inputs.constraints: Must return float-convertible residual_vector and chi2; usually the SciRel observation-residuals Operator.

outputs.name: params
outputs.description: Copy of the submitted parameter mapping.
outputs.constraints: Copied after the nested evaluation or exception handler.

outputs.name: chi2
outputs.description: Reducer-supplied squared residual or fixed exception penalty.
outputs.constraints: 1e24 on a caught nested exception; a successful reducer value is not recomputed here.

outputs.name: residuals
outputs.description: Reducer residual vector or a one-element fixed penalty.

outputs.name: equilibrium
outputs.description: Caller solver result on success; null after a caught nested exception.
outputs.constraints: Retained even when converged=False if no exception occurred.

outputs.name: failure_reason
outputs.description: Equilibrium failure_reason when not converged, exception text on a caught failure, or null for a converged trial.
outputs.constraints: An unconverged caller equilibrium may supply null; this Operator does not synthesize a reason.

preconditions: The three caller-selected ports have compatible payloads and scientific units.
solver_config supplies diagnostic R/Z grids and the equilibrium result contains declared status fields.
supported: One ordered forward-solve, synthetic-diagnostic and residual-reduction trial.
Conversion of a nested evaluation exception to the fixed one-element residual penalty.
excluded: An embedded equilibrium solver, diagnostic instrument model, parameter-bound enforcement or optimizer loop.
Distinguishing numerical failure from scientifically inadmissible states by the penalty alone.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: There is no upfront schema validation. Errors while copying solver_config or invoking/reading nested ports are caught and penalized; a params value that cannot be copied can still raise outside the handler when forming the returned record.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: A caught nested exception produces a complete penalty record. Severe failures in record construction or process-level failure can propagate.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: A returned equilibrium with converged=False still proceeds through diagnostics and residual reduction; the returned failure_reason is the caller's value, unless that path raises and is penalized.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial nested state is returned after a caught exception; equilibrium is set to null and the penalty record is returned.

provenance.lineage_summary: Maintained SciRel trial wiring from saved Pleiades inversion material with direct regression; historical candidate labels are not expert recognition.
source_kinds: saved L1 Operator contract and implementation
maintained SciRel caller-port and penalty regression

python.signature: evaluate_anisotropic_trial(*, params, observations, solver_config, equilibrium_solver, diagnostic_evaluator, residual_reducer)

example.description: Injected forward and diagnostic ports yield a two-unit normalized residual without requiring a real equilibrium solver.
example.expected: One successful caller-owned trial produces residual [2], chi2=4 and retains its equilibrium mapping.

scope: Caller-owned solver/diagnostic/reducer wiring on a small injected trial.
Nested port exception becomes residual [1e12] and chi2=1e24.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct regression establishes selected port binding and penalty behavior; it does not validate the supplied forward physics, all malformed inputs, optimizer behavior or expert recognition.
known_limitations: The broad exception handler hides the exception class in a penalty record, while retaining only its message.
A nonconverged equilibrium is still sent to diagnostics before status is read.
Public distribution licensing and SciRel expert recognition remain pending.
